desc: You gain proficiency and &Reference[Expertise] in your choice of History, Insight, Intimidation, or Persuasion. In addition, you gain rightful ownership of a small keep somewhere in the world. However, the keep is currently home to one or more monsters, which must be cleared out before you can claim the keep as yours.
Unlike the other cards from the Deck, this item will not destroy itself upon use in order to serve as a symbol of ownership of the keep.
name: throne
